description: This file defines the class DobbySpecGenerator, which provides functionality to generate a JSON specification for runtime configurations based on ApplicationConfiguration and RuntimeConfig inputs. It includes declarations of methods for creating environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other runtime components necessary for container or application setup.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing runtime specifications, including environment variables, mounts, plugins, and other settings, for application deployment.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing the runtime specification based on provided configuration objects.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing environment variables for the runtime environment.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates JSON objects for file system mounts required by the runtime.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates JSON representations for RDK plugins needed in the runtime spec.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for the minidump plugin.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for the App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for network-related plugins.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a bind mount with source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines whether GPU should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the system memory limit for the runtime.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the GPU memory limit based on configuration.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU is enabled in the runtime configuration.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing the CPU cores allocated for the runtime.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Adds default or classic plugins to the runtime specification.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ethan logging plugin.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for multicast socket plugin.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ion memory plugin.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Thunder plugin.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for OpenCDM plugin.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates JSON for private data mounts.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Adds FKPs mounts to the runtime specification.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount point JSON object.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a JSON object for resource manager mounts.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Determines and returns the working directory for the application.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes JSON data related to Ion heaps.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string for use in JSON or runtime settings.
